acceptanceCriteria: The exact fresh-repository init/index/record sequence in issue343 records one atomic trace and repeats idempotently without a pre-existing ignore rule.
A real commit, tree or unrelated worktree change is still refused; the repair does not hide tracked source changes or overwrite user ignore rules.
Main and linked worktree CLI regression, relevant private-store safety tests, focused checks and independent review pass with explicit failure and rollback evidence.
body: GitHub issue343 exact reproduction fails3/3 with current trace-fix binary. Git command instrumentation shows clean stable commit/tree and empty status until recorder creates .context-corvint/traces/.trace-operation.lock; that untracked own lock changes status digest and is misreported as external repository identity drift. Existing adapter fixtures pre-ignore .context-corvint/, hiding the missing setup boundary. Disposable info/exclude control passes two identical records with one row/same trace ID. Evidence /tmp/corvint-record-343-20260929/diagnosis.md and repro-results.json. Repair must preserve read-only init, real drift refusal and private path safety, and exercise exact fresh-repository main/linked-worktree CLI without pre-ignored fixture. No product fix yet.
title: record: prevent private trace lock from invalidating a fresh repository
